claims: Continue therapeutic anticoagulation with apixaban, verifying dose appropriateness given INR 2.1 and renal function.
Continue broad-spectrum antibiotics (cefepime, vancomycin, doxycycline, azithromycin) and reassess for de-escalation based on culture results.
Repeat complete blood count and differential to monitor leukocytosis (WBC 21.3-41.1 K/uL) and response to therapy.
Repeat basic metabolic panel and magnesium to monitor electrolytes and renal function.
Continue coagulation monitoring with PT/INR and PTT.
Monitor hemodynamics and oxygen saturation with continuous pulse oximetry and non-invasive blood pressure, given low-normal blood pressures and SpO2 93-97%.
Continue respiratory therapy with incentive spirometry and bronchodilators; monitor respiratory rate and work of breathing.
Continue venous thromboembolism and mobility precautions, including sequential compression devices and early mobilization as tolerated.
Perform a thorough skin assessment and continue pressure ulcer prevention measures.
Maintain the current ICU level of care and continue frequent reassessment of mental status, pain, and goals of care.
